reason: A multi-provider web search plugin for DeepSeek Harness that combines direct and API-based search engines, automatic fallback, and a web configuration interface.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供多搜索引擎聚合、自动故障回退和网页设置界面的 Web 搜索插件。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that aggregates multiple web search providers with automatic fallback and a web-based settings interface.

capabilities: Performs outbound HTTPS requests to configured web search providers
Supports multiple search engines with automatic fallback
Accepts and persists API keys or tokens for selected providers
Provides a web settings interface for configuring and testing search connections
